name: Kerbal Space Program 2
storyline:
"Your new space program, leaping into the cosmos... Since the dawn of Kerbalkind, we have looked to the sky and wondered what sublime mysteries lie hidden in the darkness, like jewels never beheld."

The Kerbals, a society of small green creatures, have built a space center to launch their kind into the space age. The player, assigned as Director of the Kerbal Space Center, is tasked to construct and launch vehicles to succeed at missions given by Mission Control.

After improving rockets and flying Kerbals to new unseen frontiers, secrets hidden throughout the solar system of Kerbol are uncovered. Strange monuments, hinting at the history of Kerbalkind, will lead the player further out of their home, Kerbin.
summary:
Kerbal Space Program 2 is a sequel to its award winning 2015 predecessor, space sim Kerbal Space Program. A game where you lead green creatures called Kerbals to space by constructing rockets of varying success rates.
KSP2 is planned to bring the franchise to new frontiers, with colonies, interstellar travel, and multiplayer.

As of June 28th 2024, the development studio behind it, Intercept Games, alongside Private Division, was shut down by Take Two Interactive. The Franchise is now in the hands of publisher Fictions, funded by Haveli Investments. The future of the game remains unknown as of January 2026.
